A Masterclass In Decision-Making
with Hendrie Weisinger
Evolutionary psychologist and New York
Times bestselling author Dr. Hendrie
Weisinger reveals how you can hone your
instincts to make the fast, sensible and
effective decisions that will have the most
positive impact on your life.
Dr. Hendrie Weisinger, consultant to Merrill
Lynch, UBS, Bank of America and the U.S
Justice Department, will show you how to
understand your instincts and sharpen them
for use in every aspect of modern life, from
business to relationships.
